task: put the wine bottle on top of the cabinet

windows.text: Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the wine bottle.
Approach the wine bottle from above, lowering the open gripper toward its neck.
Approach the wine bottle from above, lowering the open gripper around its neck.
Grasp the wine bottle by closing the gripper fingers around its neck.
Grasp the wine bottle by closing the gripper around its neck while it stands on the table.
Lift the wine bottle up off the table, raising it above the bowl.
Lift the wine bottle up off the table, moving it toward the cabinet.
Lift the wine bottle up off the table, raising it above the bowl.
Carry the wine bottle horizontally over the cabinet toward its top surface.
Lower the wine bottle down onto the top surface of the black cabinet.
Hold the wine bottle on top of the cabinet.
